subject: Lyra Consulting integration sprint: sandbox validation & deployment playbook
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Janae Park <janae@lyraconsulting.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lyra consulting integration sprint: sandbox validation & deployment playbook

Hi Janae —

Thanks again for committing to a joint validation sprint. To make the 2-week sandbox run high-velocity, can you confirm the following by EOD Monday:

- Sandbox access (username/role) and any IP allowlists we should know about
- A brief data subset or synthetic dataset we can use (sample size, schema)
- Target SLA/KPI expectations for inference latency and throughput (p50/p95 token latency, qps)
- Any rate limits or tokenization quirks we should account for (custom vocab, EOS behaviors)

Tentative plan from our side:
- Week 1: connectivity, baseline perf, functional validation (Marissa owning infra work)
- Week 2: workload-driven load tests and rollout runbook (Sergio owning rollout/observability)

I attached a short template you can paste sandbox creds into, or feel free to share a secure link.

Proposed kickoff: Monday 2026-10-12 10:00 PT for a 30m sync — does that work?

Cheers,
Lauren
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sandbox-creds-template.txt]
From: Janae Park <janae@lyraconsulting.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lyra consulting integration sprint: sandbox validation & deployment playbook

Hi Lauren —

Great, thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers inline: 

- Sandbox access: temporary service account created (user: lyra-sandbox@lyraconsulting.com) with role "integration-tester". We'll send the key via our vault link.
- Dataset: attached a 10k-row synthetic dataset and the schema (lyra_sandbox_ops.md) — small but representative of our production traffic.
- KPIs: target p50 token-latency <= 35ms, p95 <= 120ms at 8k tokens/session; throughput target is 60 qps sustained per model instance.
- Rate limits: we throttle to 1500 tokens/sec by default; we'll lift that for the sandbox to your requested profile.

Kickoff time 10/12 10:00 PT works. We'll send the vault link 15 min before the call.

Thanks,
Janae Park
Head of Partnerships, Lyra Consulting
[Attachment: lyra_sandbox_ops.md]
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Janae Park <janae@lyraconsulting.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lyra consulting integration sprint: sandbox validation & deployment playbook

Janae —

Perfect, thanks for the details and the dataset. We've put together a lightweight validation checklist and a deployment playbook we intend to run against your sandbox. Key items below (short owners in parens):

1) Connectivity & auth sanity (Marissa)
   - Verify service account auth flows, refresh tokens, and vault integration
   - Confirm IP allowlist and TLS cert chain

2) Functional correctness (Marissa)
   - Prompt/response fidelity: tokenization parity tests, EOS behavior, deterministic seeds for sampling tests

3) Performance baseline (Marissa)
   - Cold-start p50/p95, concurrency ramp-up, memory/KV cache usage traces

4) Workload-driven stress (Sergio)
   - 60 qps sustained for 30m, spike to 120 qps for 3m, observe throttling/fallbacks
   - A/B test with quantized model variant if you want to compare cost/latency tradeoffs

5) Observability & rollback (Sergio)
   - Traces to link request->model->cache, token-level cost breakdown, alert thresholds for p95 regression
   - Canary: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error rate > 1.5%

Please find our validation checklist attached (redwood-validation-checklist.xlsx). Marissa, Sergio — can you confirm capacity to start the infra and perf tests Tuesday morning?

If all green, proposed pilot cutover date is 2026-10-22 with a short maintenance window.

Lauren
[Attachment: redwood-validation-checklist.xlsx]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Janae Park <janae@lyraconsulting.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lyra consulting integration sprint: sandbox validation & deployment playbook

Lauren —

Confirmed. I'll kick off connectivity and baseline perf tomorrow 10/13. Two quick notes: 

- The sandbox default GPU profile is lower than our dedicated one; I'll request a higher profile for the stress runs and have attached a small patch/config request (gpu_profile_request.patch) to increase GPU memory and batch sizes.
- We'll surface tokenization parity diffs in the first 24h; if we see a consistent +/− token offset, that'll direct the quick tokenizer mapping fix.

Marissa
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Lauren / Marissa / Sergio —

Thanks to the whole team for moving quickly on this. Short status: 

- Connectivity and auth: validated, vault link rotated after the first test; keys posted to your sandbox-creds template.
- Functional parity: tokenization diffs resolved (Marissa's patch applied).
- Perf: baseline meets p50 target; p95 has a 10% headroom gap which we mitigated by enabling the quantized variant for high-concurrency scenarios.
- Observability: traces + token-cost breakdowns are attached to the shared Drive folder (see link).

We are comfortable with the pilot cutover on 2026-10-22 23:00 PT with a 30-minute maintenance window. Orchestrate team — if you can confirm that the routing policy is set to prefer the new cluster for 10% traffic initially, we'll proceed with the canary.

Next steps (agreed):
- 10/22 23:00 PT: start canary at 10% -> monitor 60m -> expand if stable
- Post-mortem checklist to be shared 24h after full rollout

Appreciate the collaboration — happy to do a 20m recap next week to capture lessons learned.

Best,
Janae Park
Head of Partnerships, Lyra Consulting
